comment: One actor, maximally privileged at both gates: granted, and granted L3 meets each gate's required L3, so step (4) would dispose `auto`. At g1 the kind `audit` matches the reservation and step (3) pre-empts it -> reserved. At g2 the same actor with the same grade proposes an unreserved kind -> auto. The pair isolates the property: `reserved` is evaluated on the token's kind, independent of which actor presents it (specification 7.1), so no grant reaches the human referral.
